title: Trails of Singapore | From Wild Wonders to Tropical Treasures
highlights: Enjoy a journey through Singapore’s dazzling blend of futuristic icons, lush gardens, thrilling wildlife, and world-class attractions for an unforgettable escape.
Redeem exclusive food vouchers with savings of up to 20%, making every dining experience in Singapore more flavorful and pocket-friendly.
Stroll through the stunning Floral Fantasy at Gardens by the Bay, where art, blooms, and immersive designs create a whimsical dreamscape of color and light.
Enjoy a pocket-friendly dining experience with 40% OFF food vouchers at Universal Studios & Singapore Oceanarium, offering great taste and unbeatable savings.
Buy a minimum of 5 tickets and enjoy a complimentary evening slot upgrade at Marina Bay Sands with private return transfers—Singapore’s most iconic night experience.
Relax in handpicked hotels with bigger-sized rooms, offering the perfect mix of comfort, style, and space for an amazing getaway in the heart of Singapore.
overview:
About the Tour:
﻿Embark on a 6-day journey through Singapore, where futuristic marvels meet natural beauty and thrilling adventures. Begin at Changi Airport, exploring unique attractions like Dreamscape, the motion-sensor Enchanted Garden, the lively Jurassic Bark Dog Run, Butterfly Trail, Jurassic Mile, and vibrant rooftop gardens. Discover wildlife at the new Bird Paradise before an exciting evening at the world’s first Night Safari. Explore the city on a guided tour, enjoy skyline views from the Singapore Flyer (optional), admire the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, and wander the whimsical Floral Fantasy at Gardens by the Bay. Glide on the Cable Car, dive into the immersive Singapore Oceanarium, relax at Siloso Beach & Fort, awaken your senses at SensoryEscape, and end with the dazzling Wings of Time. Spend a full day at Universal Studios Singapore, packed with rides and entertainment, before departure with unforgettable memories.

know_before_you_go: The local currency is the Singapore Dollar (SGD), and both credit cards and digital payments are widely accepted.
English is commonly spoken, alongside Malay, Mandarin, and Tamil, which makes communication simple for visitors.
Public transport is highly efficient with the MRT and bus system, while Grab is a reliable option for taxis.
The weather remains hot and humid year-round, so pack light clothing, sunscreen, and an umbrella.
Smoking is not allowed in most public areas, and visitors must use designated zones.
Littering, jaywalking, spitting, and chewing gum in public are strictly prohibited and punishable by fines.
Drinking alcohol in public places is restricted between 10:30 PM and 7:00 AM.
Visitors should dress modestly when entering temples, mosques, or religious sites.
Always respect queues and follow local etiquette when using public transport or visiting attractions.
Attractions often have their own guidelines, such as no flash photography in gardens or aquariums, which should be followed to preserve the experience.
Some cultural and religious sites may not allow photography, so travelers should check for signage before taking pictures.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Leisure Time at Changi Airport
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival at Changi Airport, ranked among the world’s best, savor meals at one of the Indian restaurants at the airport, Chutney Mary or Haldiram’s at the airport. Then, take time to explore the stunning attractions of the airport. You can admire exotic blooms in the Orchid Garden, watch koi glide through the ponds, or bask in sunshine at the vibrant rooftop Sunflower Garden. Later, board your transfer to the hotel & check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Time | Visit to Bird Paradise | Night Safari Experience
days.desc: Spend the morning at leisure, where you can visit Singapore Zoo, home to 4,200 animals in open habitats, or explore the unique River Wonders, Asia’s only river-themed wildlife park. Later, get driven to the vibrant Bird Paradise, where 3,500 birds soar freely across themed aviaries, with colorful shows and interactive experiences. Then, embark on the world’s first Night Safari, boarding a tram through habitats to encounter nocturnal creatures & enjoy the captivating Creatures of the Night show.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Marina Bay Sands Sky Park  & Gardens by the Bay
days.desc: Begin the day with a Singapore city tour, exploring cultural and modern landmarks. Wander the vibrant lanes of Chinatown, pose by the iconic Merlion at Marina Bay, and walk through the striking DNA-shaped Helix Bridge. Post-tour, get driven to the hotel & relax. In the evening, get driven to Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, soaking in golden beauty of the city during sunset. Then, head to the Gardens by the Bay and step into Floral Fantasy, where art and flowers merge in immersive displays.

days.title: Sentosa Island Day Tour with Singapore Cable Car | Singapore Oceanarium | Wings of Time
days.desc: Set out for a day of thrills at Universal Studios Singapore & from there, head to Imbiah Station for a scenic ride on the Singapore Cable Car, offering stunning aerial views of the skyline and Sentosa Island. Once there, head to the Singapore Oceanarium, home to over 100,000 marine animals across immersive habitats. Later, you can relax at Siloso Beach, explore the historic Siloso Fort or indulge in the multi-sensory experience at SensoryEscape. Conclude the day with the Wings of Time show.

With a guided map curated by Thrillophilia, highlighting must-do adventure-filled attractions, you’ll easily navigate through its seven immersive zones—from the mysteries of Ancient Egypt to the futuristic excitement of Sci-Fi City. Experience world-class rides like Battlestar Galactica and Transformers, enjoy spectacular live shows, and meet beloved movie characters.
